messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: @ryan (oncall) - High error rate and 5xxs for /v1/embeddings on prod-west (usw2) cluster. Impact: customers seeing failures ~30s ago. Priority: P1. Join #incident-bridge if available.
ryan (oncall): I'm on it, joining bridge now. Anyone else grab initial customer-facing ack?
mira (CS): I can send an initial customer ack for impacted accounts. Quick heads-up message ready to paste?
elena (support): yes please. short + clear. include workaround if any.
sam (SRE): i see increased tail latency on the embedding backend pods, lots of OOM kill cycles in the logs. starting a deploy rollback attempt for the last hotfix.
jin (infra): rolling back the most recent autoscaler tweak (scaledown policy) on prod-west now. watching pod churn.
ryan (oncall): good. ping me once rollback complete. I'm going to validate health endpoints and take a quick look at traces.
statusbot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-embeddings-usw2 - Affected: /v1/embeddings - Severity: P1 - Started at 1930456789.
mira (CS): Draft customer-facing ack (short):

> Hi — we’re investigating an issue affecting embedding requests in the US-West region. Some requests may fail or time out. We’re actively working on mitigation and will update you within 30 minutes. If you’re seeing retries fail, please reply with your request IDs and region.

ryan (oncall): paste that in Zendesk as an update. use subject line: "Service disruption: embeddings (US-West)"
elena (support): Zendesk macro draft (copy/paste):

```
We’re aware of an issue impacting embedding requests in US-West. Our engineers are actively investigating. If you can, please provide example request IDs and timestamps. We’ll post updates here and to the status page. Apologies for the disruption.
```

mira (CS): Intercom quick note (short):

```
We’re currently investigating intermittent failures for embeddings in US-West. We’ll update this thread as soon as we know more. Thanks for your patience.
```

sam (SRE): rollback succeeded at 1930456895, pods are restarting. early metrics look better: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 3%. still above baseline.
ryan (oncall): running quick `curl` health check across a few replicas + trace tail:

```
# healthcheck
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=embeddings -n prod-west -o name); do
  kubectl exec $pod -n prod-west -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health || echo "fail $pod"
done
```

sam (SRE): logs show a noisy retry loop from client X causing bursts; added rate-limiter rule to ingress for 60s to dampen.
jin (infra): ingress rule applied at 1930456930 — rate limit 20rps per IP for /v1/embeddings.

statusbot: Status page draft (internal):

```
Summary: We observed elevated error rates for embedding requests in US-West beginning at 2026-03-15T14:26Z. Impact: Some customers experienced failed or timed-out embedding requests. Mitigation: Rolled back a recent autoscaler change and applied a short-term ingress rate limit; continued remediation in progress. Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have substantive progress.
```

mira (CS): Customer update suggestion (more empathetic, for enterprise impacted customers):

```
Hi team — we’re actively mitigating an issue impacting embedding requests for customers routed through our US-West region. Engineers have rolled back a configuration change and applied temporary rate limiting to stabilize the service. We’re monitoring and will advise when full recovery is confirmed. If you depend on embeddings for critical workflows, we can failover you to US-East as a temporary measure — ping me and I’ll coordinate.
```

elena (support): Add a snippet in Zendesk macro for escalations: "Offer failover to US-East (manual)" with steps to open a dedicated support ticket.

ryan (oncall): current checklist I'm following (share for handoff):
- Incident summary + root cause hypothesis (config change caused pod churn)
- Actions taken: rollback autoscaler, added ingress rate-limit, monitored pod restarts
- Next steps: verify no new OOMs, watch 5xx rate for 30m, review client retry patterns, schedule postmortem
- Key artifacts: logs (gcs:/redwood/embeddings/2026-03-15), traces (jaeger link will be posted), kube events dump

sam (SRE): confirm no new OOMs after 5 minutes; 1 pod evicted earlier but now stable. 5xx down to 1.2%.

mira (CS): I'm sending a proactive email to the 3 largest customers impacted. Copy of message in thread: 

```
Subject: Incident update — embedding requests (US-West)
Hi —
We wanted to proactively let you know we’re investigating elevated failures for embedding requests in US-West. Engineers have taken mitigations and we’re seeing improvements. We’ll follow up when the incident is resolved and with a timeline for the postmortem. If you’d like us to failover your requests to another region, please let us know and we’ll prioritize.
Apologies for the disruption,
Redwood Support
```

jn (?) typo — but continuing.

statusbot: Update posted to status page (partial): "Service degraded: embeddings — mitigation in progress" at 1930456990.

elena (support): Zendesk macro for resolution (prelim):

```
We’ve deployed a rollback and temporary rate limiting which has reduced failures for embedding requests. We will continue monitoring and post when full recovery is confirmed. If you continue to see issues, please respond with request IDs.
```

sam (SRE): monitoring suggests stable for now; recommend keeping incident open for 60 minutes to observe.

ryan (oncall): agreed. I’ll do a 30m checkpoint then hand off. If anything regresses ping @ryan.

mira (CS): handoff template for next on-call (copy into #eng-oncall):

```
Handoff — INC-2026-0315-embeddings-usw2
Start: 1930456789
State: Stabilized after rollback + ingress limit. 5xx currently ~1.2% (down from 12%). Actions taken: rollback autoscaler tweak, applied short-term rate limiting, monitored pod restarts. Next: monitor 30m, investigate client retry floods, prepare postmortem.
Contacts: ryan (oncall), sam (SRE), jin (infra), mira (CS)
Artifacts: logs: gcs:/redwood/embeddings/2026-03-15, traces: jaeger/search?service=embeddings&ts=1930456789
```

elena (support): I'll attach the resolution macro once we confirm full recovery and send customer follow-ups.

sam (SRE): note for postmortem: consider hardening ingress backoff + adding request-level circuit breaker, plus a canary for autoscaler changes.

ryan (oncall): leaving bridge now, handing off to sam for ongoing monitoring. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam (SRE): taking over monitoring. will update if anything changes.

statusbot: Incident updated: status = monitoring, last update 1930457042.

mira (CS): copying final customer ack when we mark resolved.

(elena (support) reaction): :white_check_mark:
